508:t_10:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not true, $$クェス$$. I'll make sure $$チェーン$$ and $$アストナージ$$ are properly arranged for.」

508:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I see... It looks like I'll have to be prepared for the scrap heap, too...」

508:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I'm very sorry! I, AG, only wanted you to get used to me, Miss $$ハマーン$$, even one second sooner...」

508:t_10:24.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then that was my fault. I have no intention of brushing off such a kind gesture, either.」

508:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, right away! I have a request!」

508:t_10:27.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Is there truly any need to do such a thing?」

508:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a sort of induction ritual for joining $c. See...」

508:t_10:30.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「We've been down that road too.」

508:t_10:35.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Then I will steel myself.」

508:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go, then! Let's give it our all again today...!」

508:t_10:38.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This makes me look like nothing but a clown...」

508:t_10:39.en:
$$クェス$$
「There's no such thing as a clown that surly. Go apprentice yourself to $$トロワ$$.」

508:t_10:40.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(So this is $c... It seems to be a harsher unit than I expected...)

508:t_10:41.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「At this rate, it doesn't look like any customers will come today.」

508:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, it's true that you lacked a bit of charm...」

508:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What matters is calling customers in of your own will. You are most welcome here, Miss $$ハマーン$$.」

509:t_000:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Approach of a unit believed to be $$ネオ・ジオン$$ confirmed.」

509:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As expected, they came after us... Launch the mobile force.」

509:t_001:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Are you all right alone in a single unit, $$セツコ$$?」

509:t_001:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you, $$シン$$. But there's no need to worry.」

509:t_001:2.en:
$n
($$セツコ$$ senses something... Is $$バルビエル$$ coming...?)

509:t_001:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't overthink it either, $n. Our opponent is $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

509:t_001:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Maybe I've been thinking about so many things that my head has stopped working.」

509:t_001:8.en:
$$フォウ$$
「It's not bad. Sometimes feeling matters more than thinking.」

509:t_001:9.en:
$n
「My dad said something similar. ...Apparently he was just repeating something he'd heard.」

509:t_001:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then let's go natural and take down everyone who comes at us, one after another!」

509:t_001:11.en:
$$パーラ$$
「In $$ガロード$$'s case, I think he could stand to use his head a little more.」

509:t_001:12.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「So could $$シン$$ and $$キラ$$.」

509:t_001:15.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「In $$キラ$$'s case, it doesn't show on his face much, so it's more accurate to say no one can tell what he's thinking.」

509:t_001:19.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The quiet-type crew and the naturally spacey $$フリーダム$$ prince both go at their own pace, so they're about the same.」

509:t_001:20.en:
$$シン$$
「Then does looking after $$キラ$$ make me a member of the Short Straw Alliance too?」

509:t_001:21.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「...$$シン$$ needs to learn to see himself a bit more objectively.」

509:t_001:22.en:
$$五飛$$
「Learn that you can't convince others with your own logic alone.」

509:t_001:25.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$五飛$$ is probably speaking from his own experience, after all.」

509:t_001:27.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Looks like you pressed your own self-destruct switch.」
